welcome.title: Welcome, Prophet
welcome.body: I am your Spiritual Advisor. I am a pamphlet. You are a visionary with no qualifications and a field full of brambles. Together we will build something beautiful, tax-exempt and only slightly wrong.
tip.build_hall: Tap Build and place the Sermon Hall.
tip.collect: Tap the Sermon Hall to collect Devotion.
tip.ritual1: Open Ritual. Hold your First Sermon.
tip.draft1: Your sermon moved someone. Pick a convert.
tip.ritual2: One follower is a hobby. Run a Recruitment Drive.
tip.draft2: The queue is 'organic'. Pick your converts.
tip.build_greenhouse: Followers get hungry. Build a Greenhouse on Home.
tip.plant: Open Brew. Plant Basil and Nightshade.
tip.merge: While it grows: in Relics, merge up to a Manifesto.
tip.harvest: Back to Brew. Harvest both crops when ready.
tip.build_lab: Leaves alone are a salad. Build an Alchemy Lab.
tip.brew: In Brew: add Basil + Nightshade, then Brew.
tip.reporter: A notepad is at the gate. Look tax-exempt.
tip.ritual3: Something circles the lamp. Ritual: Moth to a Flame.
tip.orders: The Mothman has needs. Fill both orders.
tip.away: Close the game a minute. We'll keep the candles lit.
tip.ascension: Open the menu. Peek at Ascension. It's locked.
tip.done: The flock is "fine". Fill orders, upgrade, summon.

entity.mothman.name: The Mothman
entity.mothman.intro:
A huge winged shape lands by the lantern. Red eyes. Enormous patience.
"YOU LIT THE LAMP. I CAME. THAT IS THE ENTIRE ARRANGEMENT. ALSO, I HAVE REQUESTS."
orders.none: The board is empty. Nobody ancient wants anything. Enjoy it.
order.mothman_1.text: "BRING ME ONE NIGHTSHADE AND TWO BASIL. I AM TOLD MORTALS CALL THIS 'A SALAD'."
order.mothman_1.thanks: "ACCEPTABLE. I ATE IT NEAR A PORCH LIGHT. IT WAS THE BEST EVENING OF MY CENTURY."
order.mothman_2.text: "I REQUIRE A MANIFESTO. SOMETHING TO READ. NEAR A LAMP. DO NOT ASK WHICH LAMP."
order.mothman_2.thanks: "I HAVE READ YOUR MANIFESTO. I HAVE NOTES. MOSTLY ABOUT THE FONT. YOU HAVE MY FAVOR ANYWAY."
event.reporter.title: A Reporter Calls
event.reporter.body: A reporter from the local paper would like 'just a quick word' about the chanting, the robes and the bulk candle orders.
event.reporter.result.sample: "Amnesia Brew? Don't mind if I do." One sparkly sip and the last hour blurs. The reporter left happy with a tote bag. Suspicion falls.
event.reporter.result.no_comment: Nothing says 'nothing to hide' like a slammed gate. The reporter writes that down. Suspicion rises.
event.cat.title: A Curious Cat
event.cat.body: A cat has walked into the compound and sat on the altar. It is looking at you like it knows your real name. Adopt it?
event.cat.result.yes: The cat stays. It contributes nothing. Everyone adores it more than you.
event.cat.result.also_yes: The cat stays. It contributes nothing. Everyone adores it more than you.

entity.baba_yaga.name: Baba Yaga
entity.baba_yaga.blurb: Sets trials. Pays triple. Judges all.
entity.baba_yaga.intro:
A hut walks out of the treeline on chicken legs and sits down facing you. A voice from inside:
"So you are the one with the robes. I have chores. Do them properly and I pay well. Do them badly and I will know."
entity.jersey_devil.name: The Jersey Devil
entity.jersey_devil.intro:
Something with wings, hooves and a very long face lands on your fence and breaks it.
"HEY. You the robe guy? I live in the pines. You chant LOUD. I got a list. You do the list, I keep the reporters busy."
entity.anansi.name: Anansi
entity.anansi.blurb: Owns every story. Yours too, soon.
entity.anansi.intro:
A spider lowers itself to eye level, perfectly at ease.
"Prophet! I have heard your story. It needs work. Bring me gifts and I will pay you back, perhaps double, perhaps half. That is the fun. For me."
entity.vorl.name: Vorl, the Patient Deep
entity.vorl.blurb: Very old. Very calm. Never blinks.
entity.vorl.intro:
The pond goes dark, then deep, then much too deep. One eye opens under the water.
"...little shepherd. we have waited so long to be asked. bring what we want. we are in no hurry. you are."
order.mothman_3.text: "TWO NIGHTSHADE. FOR THE WINDOWSILL. I DO NOT HAVE A WINDOWSILL. BRING THEM ANYWAY."
order.mothman_3.thanks: "I HAVE PLACED THEM NEAR A LAMP. THEY LOOK WELL THERE. EVERYTHING DOES."
order.mothman_4.text: "A TAPER CANDLE AND TWO BASIL. I AM HOSTING. THE GUEST IS A STREETLIGHT."
order.mothman_4.thanks: "THE EVENING WAS A SUCCESS. THE STREETLIGHT SAID NOTHING. IDEAL COMPANY."
order.mothman_5.text: "MOONLIGHT TINCTURE. I HAVE SEEN THE MOON. I WOULD LIKE TO DRINK ONE."
order.mothman_5.thanks: "IT TASTES LIKE A PORCH AT TWO IN THE MORNING. YOU HAVE DONE WELL, SMALL PROPHET."
order.mothman_6.text: "TWO BROCHURES. I AM TOLD YOU HAVE 'LITERATURE'. I WILL READ IT IN A TREE."
order.mothman_6.thanks: "YOUR BROCHURE PROMISES 'ANSWERS'. IT CONTAINS A PHONE NUMBER. I RESPECT THE NERVE."
order.baba_yaga_1.text: "Four moss, four basil. Clean. If I find one snail I will send it back wearing your face."
order.baba_yaga_1.thanks: "No snails. Adequate. The hut says you may keep your face."
order.baba_yaga_2.text: "A Manifesto and three nightshade. I want to see whether you can write AND garden. Most cannot."
order.baba_yaga_2.thanks: "I read it. You confuse 'eternal' with 'long'. The nightshade was good."
order.baba_yaga_3.text: "Two Calm Draughts. The hut has been pacing. Do not ask what a hut worries about."
order.baba_yaga_3.thanks: "The hut is sitting down. First time since spring. You are useful. Do not let it go to your head."
order.baba_yaga_4.text: "A Votive candle and three moss. A proper offering. I am checking your work."
order.baba_yaga_4.thanks: "Hm. Tidy. I have met kings who could not do this. I ate them. You may go."
order.jersey_devil_1.text: "That green paste. The pesto. I put it on a mailbox once. Best mailbox I ever ate."
order.jersey_devil_1.thanks: "OH that's the stuff. I'm gonna go scream at a campsite. In a happy way."
order.jersey_devil_2.text: "Five basil. My cave smells like me. I'm told that is a problem."
order.jersey_devil_2.thanks: "Cave smells like a salad now. Bats are furious. Worth it."
order.jersey_devil_3.text: "Two taper candles. I knocked the power out again. Not on purpose. Mostly."
order.jersey_devil_3.thanks: "Lit 'em both. Romantic. Just me and my own echo. HEY. HEY. See? Echo."
order.jersey_devil_4.text: "That sludge you make when you mess up. And two moss. Don't ask. It's for a guy."
order.jersey_devil_4.thanks: "The guy loved it. The guy is me. I lied about the guy."
order.anansi_1.text: "A Holy Scripture, friend. I collect stories. Yours is short on plot, but the binding is nice."
order.anansi_1.thanks: "I have added a chapter where you lose a bet to a spider. Readers will love it."
order.anansi_2.text: "Two moonpetal, two nightshade. For a tale I am telling. The flowers play the fool. So do you."
order.anansi_2.thanks: "The audience wept. Then they paid. You get a share. I decide the share."
order.anansi_3.text: "One Zeal Tonic. I told a tiger it grants courage. He has paid in advance."
order.anansi_3.thanks: "The tiger feels very brave. The tiger is also out of pocket. Everybody wins, mostly me."
order.anansi_4.text: "A Brochure and a Taper. I am opening a rival flock. Only as a joke. Probably."
order.anansi_4.thanks: "My flock had six members by lunch. I sent them back to you. You are welcome."
order.vorl_1.text: "...an altar candle. we remember fire. it was small. it was brave. bring it to the water."
order.vorl_1.thanks: "...it went out. everything does. we are grateful. we will be grateful for a very long time."
order.vorl_2.text: "...four moonpetal. we have not seen the moon since it was new. the first time."
order.vorl_2.thanks: "...they float. we watch them float. this is the most that has happened in an age."
order.vorl_3.text: "...a calm draught and a moonlight tincture. one for each of the feelings we have."
order.vorl_3.thanks: "...we are calm. we are moonlit. we had forgotten the second one. thank you, little shepherd."
order.vorl_4.text: "...the forbidden tome. we wrote it. we would like to check something."
order.vorl_4.thanks: "...ah. a typo. page nine. it has bothered us for ten thousand years. you may keep the candle money."
